Commentary.Commentary: That's it form this game where England clinch the Plate by defeating Sri Lanka. Now, on Tuesday, the arch-rivals collide as India Under 19 and Pakistan Under 19 battle out in the middle for a place in the finals. That promises to be one exciting game. It begins at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Do join us for that game. Till then, goodbye!

England U19 skipper, George Balderson says he is very proud of his team today but is disappointed at being knocked out in the first two games of the tournament. Says they talked about how the pitch was slow and taking the pace off was the key along with the spinners bowling well. Ends by saying that this has been a great experience for the team and this has given the whole team great exposure.

Sri Lanka U19 skipper, Nipun Dananjaya, says he does not regret choosing to bowl first and he is happy with the decision. Says the batting was poor and they needed to do more. Adds that the run outs hurt them a lot as well. Ends by saying that this was a wonderful experience but unfortunately they lost today.

Dan Mousley is the Man of the Match for his ton. Mousley says that he has enjoyed opening the innings and that is his favourite position. Says that it was their plan to start the innings slowly and then catch up. Adds that his and Jack Haynes' partnership was good and they have been playing together since they were around 13 years old. Also praises Evison for his knock at the death Goldsworthy for his fantastic bowling performance.

Earlier in the game, England after being put to bat, posted a very good total on this slow surface. Century from Mousley and half tons from Haynes and Evison took them to 279. The Lankans were just not good enough with the ball and they could not pick wickets at regular intervals. And during the run chase, they lost wickets in heaps and fell miserably short of the total. Please stay tuned for the presentation.

England were excellent with the ball. Skipper Balderson struck in the very first over. Rasantha and Mishara added 45 runs between them for the second wicket and that's when Goldsworthy arrived. He started troubling the Lankans and removed Mishara to break the stand. The England players were superb with their fielding as well and deserve a lot of credit for the run outs. Eventually, Goldsworthy returned and picked up 3 wickets quickly to roll over the Lankan batting line-up and the game with a 5-fer.

The Sri Lankans could never get going in the run chase as they lost Paranavithana in the very first over. Ravindu Rasantha was the only man who could battle it out in the middle with a few quality strokes but with partners running out at the other end, his valiant effort was always going to fall short. The communication between the batters was poor during the chase was and three wickets fell in the form of run outs. Apart from Rasantha, only two other batters could manage to get into double-digit scores and that sums up the entire run chase from the Sri Lankans.

Comprehensive victory in the end. This was always coming, wasn't it? England win by a massive margin of 152 runs. The Lankans fell apart like nine-pins and the man with a fifer, Lewis Goldsworthy is getting hugs from all his teammates here.

OUT! Caught! Goldsworthy has bagged his 5-fer and he is absolutely delighted. What a brilliant performance from him! He bowls a loopy ball around off, Dilshan this time targets to go over the mid off region but ends up mistiming it. The ball goes straight to Aldridge at mid off. He pouches it comfortably and ENGLAND ARE THE 2020 UNDER-19 PLATE CHAMPIONS!
Around off, it is defended.
FOUR! Just over the man at mid on. Flighted ball on middle, Madushanka gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the man at mid on for a boundary.
Dilshan Madhushanka is the last man in.

OUT! LBW! There's number 4 for Goldsworthy and now he will surely be looking for his 5-fer. Nadeeshan is not happy but Goldsworthy won't care. A full ball on middle, Nadeeshan looks to reverse sweep but he cannot connect with it. He is hit flush on the pads. They appeal and the umpire agrees. The replays roll in and show Nadeeshan got a glove there during the reverse sweep. No wonder why Nadeeshan reacted in the way he did after the umpire raised his finger.
Short and outside off, pushed towards point.
Flatter one on middle, worked towards the leg side.
Flighted one on off, Daniel keeps it out off his back foot.
Another flatter and quicker one on middle, Daniel once again finds mid-wicket to his flick.
Quicker one on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Daniel pushes it towards covers.
Shortish and on middle, swept for a run by Kavindu to get off the mark on the 11th ball.
Around off, guided towards point.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards covers.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Ashian Daniel walks in now.

OUT! LBW! There goes the half centurion and this should be the final nail in the coffin. It is again a quicker ball which goes straight. Rasantha plays down the wrong line to miss the ball and gets hit dead in front of the stumps. The English players appeal and the umpire raises his finger quickly. Goldsworthy has his third of the innings. England just two away from clinching this Plate final.
FOUR! On the pads and punished! This is a quicker one on the pads, Rasantha glances it fine down the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.
Full and around off, it is defended towards covers.

Good shot but no runs! Full and outside off, Kavindu drives it well but straight to the man at point.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards the leg side.
Quicker one outside off, Kavindu initially looked to play at it but pulled his bat away at the last moment.

Short and on middle, Rasantha looks to pull but mistimes it towards square leg.

He shuffles across and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The England players appeal and up goes the finger after some thought. It looks like the ball would have gone on to hit the top of middle and leg pole. England just 3 wickets away from victory now.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, Thilakaratne looks to flick but misses.
Bouncer on middle and off, Thilakaratne ducks under it.
Slower ball on middle and off, defended towards the leg side.
Wide! Down the leg side, Thilakaratne lets it be. Wide signalled.
Full ball on middle and off, pushed down towards mid on for a single.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Rasantha pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, this time Thilakaratne works it towards mid on.
Around off on a length, pushed towards covers.
Length ball on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, defended towards mid off.
Good length ball on middle and off, that has taken the inside edge and then onto the pads.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Sudeera Thilakaratne is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fantastic work from Jordan Cox. Another wicket falls in the form of a run out. This is again an unfortunate way to get out. It is a length ball on middle, Wijesinghe flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and calls for a couple straightaway. They run the first one hard and as Wijesinghe returns for the second, he slips and loses his shoes too. The fielder from the deep throws the ball to the keeper. Cox collects the ball coming forward nicely and whips the bails off quickly. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The replays roll in and show that Wijesinghe is well short. The third run out of the innings and the Lankans are throwing this game away.
Is that another run out? Cox, the England keeper, is not too confident. Well, he can actually celebrate as he has done exceptional work to find Chamindu short.
On off, defended towards covers.
Landed on middle, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball on the pads, it is flicked to fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, flicked wide of the man at mid on for a single.
Shortish and just outside off, defended.
WIDE! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Rasantha goes after it but does not connect. Wided by the umpire.
Yes, he can! A dot to finish. Fuller ball around off, Chamindu comes forward and keeps it out.
Length ball around off again, Wijesinghe pushes it towards point. Good tight over so far from the England skipper. Can he finish it off well?
Another length ball on off, it is pushed towards mid off.
Length ball on middle, defended towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, this time Chamindu drives it through covers for a brace.
Short and outside off, punched to deep cover for a run by Rasantha.
George Balderson is back on! 2-0-18-1 from him so far.
Another full ball on middle, Rasantha flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot.
Bouncer on middle, it is pulled towards fine leg for a run.
Length ball on middle, Wijesinghe works it towards the leg side for a single.
Low full toss on off, Wijesinghe looks to drive but gets an under edge towards cover.
Bowling change! Scott Currie is back on. 3-1-17-0 from him so far.
Down the leg side, Wijesinghe looks to flick but misses. The keeper fumbles and concedes a bye.
On the pads on a length, it is easily nudged towards mid-wicket for a run.
Landed around off, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled for a single to deep mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, it is guided towards point.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! That brings up the half ton for Rasantha. It is a short ball on middle, Rasantha pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball is rolling towards the fielder there but as it gets closer to him, it bounces extra and sneaks through his legs to the rope. He is the last hope that Sri Lanka have of rescuing this game.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length ball outside off, Chamindu looks to cut but misses.
Good length ball on off, blocked off the back foot.
Landed on off, defended back to the bowler.

Good length ball on off, pushed towards point.
Good length ball around off, Chamindu pushes it back to the bowler.
Kasey Aldridge is back into the attack. 4-0-20-0, his figures so far.
Another short ball outside off, it is guided towards point.
Short of a length ball around off, tapped towards point.
FOUR! Pulled away! This should release some pressure from the Lankans. A short of a length ball on middle, Rasantha picks the length early and whacks it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot.

Almost another run out! Short of a length ball outside off, it is pushed towards point. The batters go for the quick single which is not on. The fielder there picks the ball quickly and fires the throw at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would've been all over for Rasantha and maybe all over for Sri Lanka as well.
Short and outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
Full and outside off again, a single to end the over as it is stroked for a single to sweeper cover.
Flatter and around off, pushed back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Aldridge had almost pulled off a stunner but Rasantha survives. Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Rasantha after facing 5 consecutive dot balls looks to force a single towards the leg side. However, he chips this one towards Aldridge at mid-wicket who dives forward. He gathers the ball and England start to celebrate. The umpires are not sure about it and Rasantha is also not going anywhere. The umpire refers it upstairs. Replays roll in and there is conclusive evidence that the ball bounced just before going into Aldridge's hands. England's celebrations shortened and Rasantha lives to die another day.

DRINKS BREAK! It has been all England in the first hour of this run chase. They have bowled well to get wickets and they have got assistance from the Lankan batters too. A couple of them have became victims of run outs and are in complete disarray. Ravindu Rasantha is the only man who is battling it out in the middle but has not got much support from the others. He needs one of the players to hang out in the middle and build a stand along with him. Will they be able to do so or will England keep chipping away with the wickets?

Loopy delivery on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bull's eye from Haynes! Dinusha is sold a dummy down the river though. A length ball on middle, Rasantha works it towards mid-wicket and calls for the run. Sonal responds and takes off too but Rasantha sends him back. Dinusha backtracks and tries to get back in but Haynes from mid-wicket scores a direct hit. No need to go to the third umpire for this one as Sonal is not even in the frame. Tough luck for the non-striker. Half the side back in the hut for Sri Lanka.
Chamindu Wijesinghe is the new man in.
He starts with a shortish ball on middle, Dinusha works it towards the leg side and takes a run.
George Hill is on now.

An appeal for LBW but runs given! A full toss on middle, Sonal looks to paddle it but he does not time it well. It takes the edge and goes towards square leg. A run taken.

Quicker one around off and middle, Dinusha blocks it off his back foot.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.

The England players appeal and the umpire agrees instantly. Another wicket goes down for Sri Lanka and the situation is going from bad to worse from them. Sonal Dinusha is the new man in for Sri Lanka.
Around off, pushed through mid off for a single.
On middle, blocked.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
Full ball on off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
1 wide.
Full ball on middle and off, pushed towards long on for a couple.

Length ball on off, pushed towards cover.
On the pads, flicked towards the leg side for a single.

On off, blocked off the back foot.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is really unlucky for the Lankan skipper. He walks off with disbelief on his face. England would not care though. A full ball outside off, Nipul squeezes it towards point and takes off for a single. Mousley there gets to the ball, picks it up and fires the throw at the non-striker's end. He hits and the third umpire has been called for. Replays roll in and show that while completing the run, Dananjaya got into a tangle with the bowler, Goldsworthy. That stopped Dananjaya in his stride. Did Dananjaya drag his bat down in time? He did that while getting inside the crease but as the ball hit the stumps, the bat again went up in the air. The third umpire takes his time to check with a few angles and then in the end signals it out.

Who walks in now? Ahan Wickramasinghe has walked out to rescue Sri Lanka from a perilous situation. He had injured his left wrist while fielding in the first innings and it will be difficult for him to bat on a spinning track.

Run out appeal taken upstairs. Did he ground the bat there? Looks really close. He gets in a tangle with the bowler while trying to get to his crease. His bat is in the air when the ball hits the stumps but before that, he did drag his bat in and then it went over. Well, the umpire thinks this is out. Interesting call from the third umpire.
Around off, Dananjaya keeps it out.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Nipun leans into the drive and slams it through point for a boundary. Glorious shot this one.

FOUR! Drilled! Aldridge overpitches this one on off and Rasantha slams it past the man at covers for a boundary.
A slip comes in now.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot towards cover.
Length ball around off, worked towards mid on.

Length ball outside off, Rasantha taps it towards point.
Change of ends for Kasey Aldridge.
On off, pushed back to the bowler. Successful over for England comes to the end.

OUT! LBW! Goldsworthy strikes in his first over! A flatter delivery this time by Goldsworthy, angling in. Mishara looks to go back and work this one towards the leg side but misses and he is hit on the back pad. The England players appeal and up goes the dreaded finger. That looks plumb to the naked eye, crashing into middle and leg. Mishara walks back after a disappointing knock.
Floated ball on middle and off, flicked towards the man at mid-wicket and the batters take one.
On the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
Floated on middle and off, flicked towards wide long on for a single.

Bowling change! Time for spin as Lewis Goldsworthy comes into the attack.
Another length ball outside off, blocked.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot.
FOUR! Pierces the gap to perfection this time. This is poor bowling from Currie. He bowls a length ball outside off, Kamil slams it between cover and point and the ball races away to the fence.

Down the leg side, Rasantha shuffles and looks to flick but misses.

Almost chopped on! Another one around off, this time angled in. Rasantha looks to play at it towards the off side but he gets an inside edge which just about hits the pads and the ball stays right near his boot.

FOUR OVERTHROWS AND A COUPLE MORE! These are bonus runs for the Lankans! Shortish and around off, Rasantha works it towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs. The fielder there throws the ball towards the keeper who tries to run the non-striker out. He misses and the ball goes to the fence at long on. There was almost no back up and England should have done better to stop this from happening.
Good length ball around off, pushed to point.

Huge appeal for caught behind but not out says the umpire. Currie bends his back and bowls a bouncer down the leg side, Rasantha looks to pull but misses. The English players appeal but nothing from the umpire.

FOUR! Mishara is off the mark in style too! Excellent finish to the over for Sri Lanka. Balderson overpitches and bowls it wide outside off, Kamil leans into the drive and slams it through covers. 17 runs from the over.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Around off on a length, it is turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Make that third boundary in a row. This is classy batting from Rasantha. A length ball on middle from the English skipper, Rasantha whips it off his pads and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Brilliant shot, this time to the other side of the ground. Slightly shortish ball outside off, Rasantha rides the bounce and punches it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Whacked away! Short and on middle from Balderson, Rasantha rocks on the back foot and slams it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bouncer on middle, Mishara ducks under it. Maiden to start from Currie.

Landed around off and middle, blocked off the back foot.
Another good length ball outside off, Mishara taps it towards point once again.
Another short ball, Mishara once again cuts well but once again fails to beat the man at point.
Good length ball outside off, Mishara cuts it to point.
Scott Currie to bowl from the other end.

OUT! Caught! England strike in the first over, just like Sri Lanka. Paranavithana falls for a duck. It is a length ball on middle, Paranavithana looks to flick but the ball stops on the surface and hits the upper part of the bat. It lobs straight to Hamidullah Qadri at mid-wicket. He takes the catch easily and an early blow to Sri Lanka. Ravindu Rasantha is the new man in for the Lankans.
Shortish around off, defended off the back foot.

Leading edge there! A length ball on middle, it stops on the surface a bit as Paranavithana looks to work it down the leg side. The ball takes the leading edge and goes to the right of the bowler.  Balderson though fails to even try to catch the ball.
WIDE! False start from Balderson as he strays down the leg side. Paranavithana looks to flick but misses. Called wide.

We are back for the run chase! The England players are in a huddle right now. They get the final word from the skipper. Navod Paranavithana and Kamil Mishara, the two openers for Sri Lanka walk out to the middle too. England Skipper, George Balderson, will take the ball first up for his side. Here we go...
